title: 3-round AES-192: parameter-collision relation

target.description: AES-192: rounds2–4 map I2 to I5; each internal round includes MixColumns and standard left ShiftRows. The article explicitly targets AES-192/256.

setting.key_relation: Three fixed, unknown round keys. Master-key dependencies are not used in the component argument.
setting.key_population: general secret key; no restriction to a weak-key family
setting.plaintext_model: Fix the12 bytes outside column0 of I2. The active function input is I2_00; (I2_10,I2_20,I2_30) is a three-byte parameter.
assumptions: Birthday collision estimates assume random-like32-bit internal tuples; the approximate0.5 source estimate is distinct from exact distinguishing advantage.

property.statement: Equality of the four8-bit parameter-dependent subexpressions is sufficient for equality of I5_00 for every active I2_00 value under the same fixed keys.
property.quantifier: For fixed keys and the other12 input bytes, a pair of parameter triples with the same32-bit internal tuple induces equal functions on all256 input values. Existence among a sampled family is a birthday heuristic, not a universal every-key guarantee.
property.scope: Three internal AES rounds2–4; one-byte projected functions. The article labels the extension through round5 as a four-round distinguisher.
